summary: The product-depth induction is valid for nonnegative weights, including zero-depth cases. The multilinear selector remains in C on the product of simplices, and the accepted joint concavity fact yields the required factorized fiber-depth lower bounds. The separate atomic centerpoints are integral and must lie in their simplices; the multi-affine counting lemma then applies to every ambient halfspace, with injectivity ensuring distinct fiber contributions. The zero-energy, vertical-halfspace, whole-space, uniform-depth, and asymmetric-box boundary cases are all handled correctly, and the stated constants follow exactly.
